description.narrative: The Central African Republic (CAR) Humanitarian Fund is a pooled mechanism that relies on coordinated efforts to deliver humanitarian assistance across the country. Allocations support projects that prioritize one or more of the Coordinated Aid Programme strategic priorities, and partners embrace a rights-based approach in providing humanitarian, emergency, and recovery assistance.
